Comments: After calculating the project-wide metrics using MetricsTree, the overall results show a medium level of code quality.
The system presents acceptable coupling and flexibility, but several classes (especially PdfService and TaskService) have high complexity and low cohesion.
The maintainability index is relatively low (≈17), suggesting the need for refactoring in specific areas to improve clarity and testability.
